orchestrators.name: jarvis
orchestrators.description: Main orchestrator responsible for analyzing the user query and deciding which agent or tool should be invoked.

agents.name: SystemOperationsAgent
agents.description: Agent responsible for performing system-level operations such as executing terminal commands.

tools.name: terminal
tools.description: Execute commands in the system terminal and return the command output.

tools.name: getTerminalHistory
tools.description: When the terminal command did not return the entire output or did not return the output at all. You can use this tool to get the next output, or see what the terminal has returned.

tools.name: speak
tools.description: Once all operations are completed use this tool to inform the user of the the completion status, this can also be used for general communication with the user, or it can be used if the LLM has any questions that it wants to ask the user.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The query the LLM wants to ask.
